unit_label: Parallel Run — secondary public architecture handbook
claims_supported: Parallel run calls both old and new implementations for the same work and compares outputs.
Only one implementation is authoritative at a time; the old is normally authoritative until verification.
Parallel run is reserved for high-risk functionality and needs functional and nonfunctional verification.
The page distinguishes parallel run from canary by exposure, and calls parallel run a way to implement dark launching.
limitations: Secondary public handbook, not a specification or benchmark.
